description: This file defines an abstract PHP class `ReportDataAPI` within the namespace `OrangeHRM\Core\Api\Rest`. The class provides a REST API endpoint for retrieving report data, including validation, access checks, and data normalization. It serves as a base class for specific report data endpoints, encapsulating common logic for handling report retrieval and validation.

classes.name: ReportDataAPI
